hero.subtext: Real-time polls, slides, and AI analysis for presenters. Participants vote by QR code — no app required.

pillars.heading: Everything a presenter needs in one place
pillars.subtext: From the first slide to the final summary without switching between tools

poll.title: Engage the room
poll.desc: 8 real-time poll formats: from mood temperature to Planning Poker. Participants vote by QR code without installing any app.

screen.title: Control the screen
screen.desc: Splash slides, speaker cards, schedules, Spin Wheel, and announcements — all displayed on the projector with one click from the host panel.

ai.title: Analyse the results
ai.desc: YandexGPT surfaces key themes from hundreds of questions in seconds. After the event, hit 'AI Summary': 3–5 sentences with insights from all polls.

features.title: Q&A without chaos
features.desc: 200 questions from the audience? AI highlights 3 main themes in seconds. You answer what matters, not drown in the stream.

features.title: Full control
features.desc: Questions don't appear on screen automatically. You choose what to show with one click.

features.title: AI summary after the event
features.desc: Click '✨ AI Summary' after finishing. YandexGPT analyses all polls and questions, producing 3–5 sentences of insights for your report.

slides.desc: Control what the room sees without leaving the host panel. Slides launch with one click next to polls in a unified lineup.

items.title: Splash screen
items.desc: Event name, date and venue while the audience gathers

items.title: Speaker card
items.desc: Photo, title, topic — automatically displayed before they take the stage

items.title: Schedule
items.desc: Current block highlighted, past blocks crossed out

items.title: Spin Wheel
items.desc: Prize draw or random participant selection in 3 seconds

quiz.desc: Enable quiz mode and a poll becomes a game. Answers are hidden, results locked — you reveal them when you want. The room waits to see their place on the leaderboard.

features.title: Answers hidden until you signal
features.desc: Nobody knows the result until you reveal it. Maximum suspense in the room.

features.title: Instant feedback on phones
features.desc: 'Correct' or 'Wrong': everyone knows their result in the same second.

features.title: Leaderboard fires up the room
features.desc: Top 5 on the main screen. The audience cheers the winner and asks for another round.

pollTypes.heading: 8 formats for any task
pollTypes.desc: One click changes the question type. Mix formats within a single event.

howItWorks.heading: Three steps to your first poll

steps.title: Create an event
steps.desc: Add polls and slides in a unified lineup. Templates speed up the start.

steps.title: Show the QR code
steps.desc: One screen with the code and the audience connects. No app, no sign-up.

steps.title: Launch and analyse
steps.desc: Activate questions in real time. AI processes Q&A and prepares a summary.

pricing.heading: Start for free
pricing.desc: Upgrade to a paid plan when you grow.

cta.subtext: Create your first event in 2 minutes. No credit card required.
